answer: Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 150 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. Deposits are visible in canyon, and jade reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 32% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Each duplicate costs another 37 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
